browserRecovery.cause: The harness assumed two JavaScript animation frames imply Flutter interaction completion. In this hasTouch WebKit context the correct Close target received pointerdown/up but no DOM click. Flutter's installed ClickDebouncer queues tappable pointer events and flushes them after its 200ms deadline when no click arrives. The public board returned automatically after that engine processing; the earlier assertion observed a valid pending input, not a stuck application or incorrect target.
browserRecovery.recommendedHarnessChange: In composition(), after exactly one close.click(), await close.waitFor({state:'hidden',timeout:3000}), then publicHeading(page).waitFor({timeout:3000}), then frame(page). Preserve all existing count, geometry, state and command assertions. No arbitrary sleep or repeat click.
